subject: Argos
author: hn6
body: Got the ultimate box for £9.99 last week from Argos after my last disc cracked.

subject: Not The Ultimate Box
author: ZombieTron
body:
But, as you still have to use the gig or so on your hard drive for the newer updates, the only benefit of having the Ultimate Box is the party pack.

The Ultimate Box at Play.com is £24.99, so you will save money by buying the £9.99 original version and adding the Party Pack yourself. 🙂
